obligations.invariant: Approved ASCII dot-atom/DNS-label grammar, local <=64 octets, total <=254, normalized key is explicit ASCII A-Z to a-z translation of email; preserve local spelling, lowercase domain in display email; no trimming/alias merging
obligations.mechanism: DB reviewed CHECK/immutable normalization function; backend independently validates same grammar. Reject a mismatched supplied canonical key. No citext/provider alias rules or Unicode folding.
tests: reject non-ASCII, whitespace/controls, bad labels/atoms, overlong values and mismatched raw/key direct writes; dots/plus-tags remain significant

obligations.invariant: email_normalized VARCHAR(320) uses deterministic C collation
obligations.mechanism: DB sets explicit column collation in reviewed SQL; Prisma cannot represent it
tests: inspect installed column/index collation; identity comparisons independent of database locale

obligations.invariant: One global normalized identity, including suspended/deactivated accounts
obligations.mechanism: DB applies immediate users_email_normalized_key UNIQUE; offline Prisma declares it but no database object exists yet; no active-only partial unique, recycling or account merging
tests: concurrent case-variant creates/renames yield at most one committed identity; conflict never transfers historical ownership; outward registration/recovery response stays neutral

obligations.invariant: status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DEACTIVATED'), required VARCHAR(20), no default
obligations.mechanism: DB immediate CHECK; services authorize transitions, ACTIVE never grants staff privilege
tests: reject unknown/lowercase/NULL status, forged customer status, and attempts to bypass last-active-Super-Admin policy

obligations.mechanism: DB immediate CHECK; controlled deactivation records database time and retains identity/email reservation; no restoration/retention policy inferred
tests: reject both incoherent status/time combinations; deactivation leaves history unchanged and cannot bypass privileged-user safeguards

obligations.invariant: phone_e164 IS NULL or literal + then 1..15 ASCII digits, first digit nonzero; no uniqueness
obligations.mechanism: DB CHECK with complete input consumption/character exclusion; trusted backend validates independently; contact shape is not possession or recovery authority
tests: allow duplicate canonical contact phones and NULL; reject empty, spaces, extensions, controls, >15 digits, missing + or leading zero; never guess country prefix

obligations.invariant: Required display_name VARCHAR(160), no fallback; reject empty name; registration requires displayName
obligations.mechanism: DB required column, length and nonempty CHECK; later API validates independently. Whitespace/Unicode presentation normalization beyond nonempty remains a later reviewed UX/API detail, no silent ASCII-only name policy.
tests: reject missing/empty/overlong name and unauthorized fallback; allowed Unicode names not restricted by email ASCII policy

obligations.invariant: Initial 1, version >=1; each controlled UPDATE requires NEW.version = OLD.version+1; no wrap/reset, reject INTEGER overflow
obligations.mechanism: DB default/check and BEFORE UPDATE rejection guard; trusted writer supplies the increment. Stored version is never mass-assigned from DTO.
tests: reject zero/negative/skipped/unchanged/decreased version, forged assignment and overflow; rollback preserves old version

obligations.invariant: Sensitive writes use id + expectedVersion precondition; stale updates have no effect
obligations.mechanism: Trusted transactional update predicate and controlled writer protocol; row lock/re-read for multi-step identity changes. Increment trigger alone cannot enforce the caller's expected read version.
tests: two same-version updates produce at most one successful effect; no silent edit retry/lost update; fault after side effect rolls back identity/audit consistently

obligations.invariant: id and created_at immutable; updated_at = statement_timestamp() on UPDATE
obligations.mechanism: DB BEFORE UPDATE guards, no Prisma @updatedAt or UUID default; trusted backend supplies UUID v4
tests: reject immutable-field changes, override forged update timestamp, verify defaults/precision and rollback

obligations.invariant: Keep current email until one-time proof of replacement; activation atomically changes email/key/verification with expected version and uniqueness recheck
obligations.mechanism: Later AUTH controlled challenge consumption/finalization and same-transaction audit through A; runtime cannot directly forge email_verified_at. No challenge/session tables or TTLs chosen here.
obligations.owner: Later AUTH/ACCOUNT + A + DB; scoped Security review for session consequences
tests: unverified, wrong-user/target/version, expired/replayed proof, duplicate target and mid-operation fault cannot change current identity; review notification/reauth/session-revocation behavior before AUTH

obligations.invariant: No ordinary runtime DELETE/TRUNCATE or protected-field bypass; retain historical identities and prohibit user-supplied privilege claims
obligations.mechanism: DB reviewed role grants/denials and controlled sensitive write routines with safe ownership/search_path; future actual user FKs RESTRICT deletion/update under M-04. No fake FK, staff flag, credentials or sessions in User.
obligations.owner: DB + later AUTH/ACCOUNT/STAFF_API; A for audit; later referencing schema owners
tests: runtime destructive/privileged direct writes denied; customer role/admin/status/verification mass assignment denied; later historical FK restrictions proven; separate audiences/memberships/resource policies still required
